description: Monthly billing: whether the account is billed monthly or prepaid, its status (off, awaiting_card, active, retrying or held, and why it is held), the credit limit and what is owed now (on monthly billing the balance goes below zero down to the limit, and what is owed is charged to the saved card on the 1st), the saved card, when the next charge runs, the amount to pay with Pay now after a failed charge, and the 6 most recent charges. Useful when a send is refused with INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE on an account with a negative balance. Read-only; HonkIO staff switch monthly billing on.
name: get_monthly_billing
title: Get monthly billing
